_comment: Agent command templates for `pr-sweep run --platform NAME`.  argv is the command; `{prompt}` becomes the whole worker prompt as one argument, `{prompt_file}` a 0600 temp file holding it, and `stdin: true` pipes it on standard input.  `auto_flags` are added only with `--auto-approve` (the operator's explicit choice; without them a headless CLI may stop at its first permission prompt).  `model_flag` plus `models` map the plan's tier (small, mid, frontier) to a model; omit them to use the CLI's default model.  `trailer` is the commit trailer sentence rule 13 gets.  The seat is never set here: workers inherit the AGENT_SEAT of whoever runs the sweep.  `checked` says what was verified on this Mac (Sat, Oct 17, 2026) from the CLI's own --help.

claude.trailer: End every commit message with the trailer: Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
claude.checked: claude --help: -p/--print reads the prompt from stdin, --model, --dangerously-skip-permissions

codex.checked: codex exec --help: with no PROMPT the instructions are read from stdin; -m MODEL; --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox
